name: CIDB contractor registration (Act 520)

specifications.basis: CIDB Malaysia web page read 25 Nov 2026: 'Akta 520 adalah satu tindakan untuk membentuk Lembaga Pembangunan Industri Pembinaan Malaysia (CIDB) pada tahun 1994'; scope includes contractor registration, material standards and responsibility for construction safety. No registration fee/levy rate is printed on the page read.

notes: Product/catalogue record from a page read in the GEG plant WBS sweep.
